services.catalogue.title: Services
services.catalogue.intro: The region's services: which are configured, and which this office offers.
services.catalogue.name: Service
services.publish.title: Publish a version
services.publish.intro: The form and workflow the region publishes for this service, and what offices below may change.
services.publish.family.payment: How the fee is paid (at the office or elsewhere, days to pay)
services.publish.conflicts: These overrides of offices below no longer fit the new version (they stay, and are passed over):
services.override.title: An office's configuration
services.override.intro: What the office gets, where each value comes from, and its own changes (made from the office above it).
services.override.resetDone: The office's own changes are removed.
services.override.readOnly: An office never changes its own: the office above it does.
services.override.changed: Someone else changed it meanwhile. Check it and change it again.
services.override.notConfigured: This service is not configured yet.
services.request.title: New request
services.request.intro: The services this office offers. Choose one, then fill in its form.
services.request.noForm: This service has no form to fill in: the request starts its case.
services.request.none: This office offers no configured service yet.
services.override.resetConfirm: The office's own changes are removed: it gets what it inherits again.
services.contract.missing: The effect {effect} needs the field "{key}": the form does not have it at its top level.
services.contract.wrong_kind: The effect {effect} needs "{key}" to be a {expected} field; it is a {actual} field.
services.contract.not_required: The effect {effect} needs "{key}" to be required.
services.contract.conditional: The effect {effect} needs "{key}" always shown: a condition can hide it.
services.contract.computed: The effect {effect} needs "{key}" answered on its own: it is computed from other fields.
services.contract.no_form: The effect {effect} reads the request form: the version names none.
services.contract.restricted: The effect {effect} needs "{key}" filled by everyone: it is kept from some roles.
services.contract.no_contract: The effect {effect} reads nothing from the form: it takes no mapping.
services.contract.unknown_path: The effect {effect} reads no "{key}": check the mapping.
services.contract.fee_rule_off: The fee rule is switched off.
services.contract.fee_rule_not_approved: The fee rule version is not approved yet: another person approves it first.
services.contract.fee_rule_not_regional: The fee rule is an office's own, not the region's.
services.contract.fee_input_sensitive: The fee reads "{key}", a Sensitive field: a fee may not read Sensitive answers.
services.contract.fee_not_reassessed: The workflow changes the request without working its fee out again: add the effect {effect} to each transition that changes the request.
services.contract.fee_field_without_rule: The form shows a fee, but the version names no fee rule.
services.contract.fee_field_conditional: The Fee field must always be shown: a condition or a role restriction hides it.
services.contract.fee_field_missing: The version charges a fee, but its form shows none: add a Fee field, so the counter sees the fee it files.
services.override.approvalUnit: The office that gives final approval
services.override.rule.level: The office of level {level} above it
services.errors.policy_refuses: The service's policy does not let this office change {keys}.
services.errors.not_offered: {code} is not offered by this office.
services.errors.no_fee_now: The service charges no fee now.
services.errors.version_changed: Version {expected} was changed; read it again.
services.errors.version_unusable: The service's workflow or form is switched off, or names an effect no longer installed.
services.publish.unguarded_service: Transition {transition} of the workflow gives the service without checking that its fee is paid: guard it on payment.settled.
